definitions.C: events where both legs fill exactly five contracts inside the guarded lawful Window 1
definitions.PC: events satisfying C with negative combined Window-1-close delta
definitions.S: events satisfying C whose two entry VWAP costs sum below 100 cents
definitions.IC: events satisfying C whose two individual Window-1-close deltas are both negative

reference_law.per_leg_window1_close: last positive-size exchange-identified deduplicated true print at or before that event's strict positive start cutoff and at or after T-8h
reference_law.individual_delta: leg fill VWAP cents minus per-leg Window-1-close cents
reference_law.combined_delta: sum of the two individual deltas
reference_law.missing_reference: PC and IC are false/unknown, never success; C remains a fill fact

missing_event_law: every missing, uncertain, thin, corrupt, contradictory, censored, or error event remains in D and is never success
